verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is fundamentally a REST API with official Python/Node SDKs, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a Batch API for asynchronous headless workloads, all of which support scripted/CI usage without any UI dependency (cerebras-docs-1, cerebras-docs-3, cerebras-docs-8, cerebras-docs-17, cerebras-gh-2). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) and independent confirmation of headless automation beyond coding-agent integrations.
